testCase.name: [dev] S11 Status changes survive navigation, context switches and reload, stay with their own patient, and pre-select their own context's template

descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-92584 AC 1; TFA-92599 AC 'No cross-contamination of data/templates between contexts' · “No cross-contamination of data/templates between contexts”.

Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S11 Status changes survive navigation, context switches and reload, stay with their own patient, and pre-select their own context's template

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 The physician can change the badge by hand at any time (before or after Generate, and on a patient whose status already rolled) through all three states, and each change persists (list, chart, reload … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 1)
  • U8 The badge pre-selects the template at Generate: Hospital New Admission -> H&P, Follow-up -> SOAP progress, Consult -> Consult note; … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 6; TFA-92584 AC 7)
  • U12 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (step 7, ground rule 3.3) (UAT TC-06; UAT 3.3; TFA-92584 AC 7)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Session fixture with one Hospital patient and one resident, both untouched

When Set the Hospital patient to Consult, back to list; switch to Nursing Home (resident still Follow-up); set the resident to New Admission, look at its Encounter tab, back to list; switch to Hospital, open the chart, reload, Encounter tab

Then Each list shows only its own patient's status; the resident's change does not touch the Hospital patient and vice versa; the resident pre-selects SNF admission and the Hospital patient Consult note, never a template from the other context or from the other patient's status; Consult survives the reload

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs list text + [selected] option per checkpoint; list anchors as in S01. Template checks are on [selected] only: whether a Hospital chart lists SNF templates at all is TFA-92599 AC 5 (gated, covered in TC-21) and is kept out, so a TFA-92599 gap neither shows here as a TC-06 Fail nor turns this scenario Blocked

Where it ran: dev unit U21; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S11 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 8b4be94 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-19T17:04:37Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.

UAT item: TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-06/S11

Status changes survive navigation, context switches and reload, stay with their own patient, and pre-select their own context's template

Tickets: TFA-92584 Admission Status Toggle (ready for qa)

Result: Pass from scripts/oracle.mjs on the saved evidence (units/U21.verdict.json), unit U21 split by its parts' checkpoints. Agent: 84 turns, 242 s, $0.68.

Plan: unit U21 (#21, ready-for-qa, ui-only) — Admission badge set by hand. Same legacy seed, same control. TC-06 S11 runs first: its s11-n-list-before checkpoint needs the resident on Follow-up with no Consult / New Admission, which only the fresh legacy seed guarantees. TC-01 S04 then sets every badge itself and saves a checkpoint after each change, so it does not depend on where S11 left the patients. Runs together with TC-01/S04.

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #21, U21; checked: yes): Pass — badge per chart/context never leaks (S11); all three badge states shown on list cards in both modes (S04)
